title: Cervical AM
summary: Daily morning neck and upper-back routine for cervical DDD and forward head posture. Do before golf or exercise. Stop if arm or finger numbness worsens.

steps.name: Chin Tuck (Cervical Retraction)
steps.cue: Glide head straight back as if on a shelf, eyes level, no tilt. Hold 3–5 sec. Feel it mid-neck, not at the skull base. Stop if pain runs into the arm or fingers.

steps.name: Craniocervical Nod
steps.cue: Lie on back. Tiny 10° 'yes' nod without lifting the head; hold 10 sec, relax 5. Feel the front of the throat, not the outer neck. Stop if outer neck takes over. Never skip.

steps.name: Thoracic Extension — Foam Roller
steps.cue: Roller across mid-back, hands support head. Drape and breathe ~45 sec, then move up one segment (3–4 spots). Mid/upper back only, never low back or neck. Stop if sharp or radiating pain.

steps.name: Thoracic Rotation — Quadruped
steps.cue: Hands and knees, one hand behind head. Elbow down toward opposite wrist, then open to the ceiling; eyes follow the elbow. Rotate from the upper back; hips and low back stay still.
